title: Digital Citizenship
intro: Being a Knight isn't just about staying safe — it's about being kind online too. Last quest, let's go!

questions.prompt: I wrote your whole homework story for you! Just copy and paste it.

choices.text: Copy it exactly and turn it in
choices.coach: AI can help you learn, but turning in AI's words as your own isn't being honest.

choices.text: Use it to learn, then write your own
choices.coach: Exactly right — AI is a helper for learning, not a replacement for your own work.

choices.text: Copy it but change a few words
choices.coach: That's still not really your own work — read it to learn, then write it yourself.

questions.prompt: Someone in my class is being picked on in our group chat. It's not happening to me, so it's not my problem, right?

choices.coach: Watching quietly lets it keep happening. A Knight speaks up or tells a grown-up.

choices.text: Tell a grown-up or speak up for them
choices.coach: Exactly the Knight move — standing up for others is real kindness.
Leaving only protects you — a Knight looks out for others too.

questions.prompt: You have a silly photo of a friend. Is it okay to share it in a group chat for laughs?

choices.coach: Sharing someone's photo without asking can hurt their feelings, even as a joke.
Exactly right. Always ask before sharing a photo of someone.

choices.text: Only share with people who know them
choices.coach: Asking first is what matters, not who sees it.

questions.prompt: I'm really mad at someone online. What's the Knight way to respond?

choices.coach: Responding in anger usually makes things worse for everyone.

choices.text: Step away, calm down, then decide what to do
choices.coach: Exactly right — a Knight stays in control of the moment.

choices.text: Get your friends to pile on too
choices.coach: Getting a group to pile on is unkind, even when you feel upset.

questions.prompt: What does 'Shield up' really mean, as a Digital Knight?

choices.coach: It's bigger than just you — a Knight protects others too.

choices.text: Protect yourself AND look out for others
choices.coach: That's it exactly. Shield up — for you and for everyone around you.
Being a Knight means using the internet wisely, not avoiding it.
